proposals.title: stockholder proposal regarding report on lobbying
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual report disclosing direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, recipients, model legislation memberships, and oversight decision-making processes.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because Chevron already provides extensive disclosure on its lobbying activities and expenditures.

proposals.title: stockholder proposal to create board committee on climate risk
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board charter a new Board Committee on Climate Risk to evaluate climate strategy and report to the full board on climate risks and opportunities.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because the full Board already has oversight of the Company's strategy, including the Company's response to climate change

proposals.title: stockholder proposal regarding report on climate lobbying
proposals.topic_summary: Requests evaluation and report on whether Chevron's direct and trade association lobbying aligns with Paris Agreement goals and plans to mitigate misalignment.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because your Board believes that a special report is duplicative.

proposals.title: stockholder proposal regarding report on petrochemical risk
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report assessing public health risks of expanding petrochemical operations in areas prone to climate-induced storms, flooding, and sea level rise.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because Chevron Phillips Chemical Company LLC, the joint venture through which Chevron invests in petrochemical operations

proposals.title: stockholder proposal regarding report on human rights practices
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an independent third-party report evaluating effectiveness of Chevron's efforts to prevent, mitigate and remedy human rights impacts of its operations.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal. Chevron is committed to supporting and maintaining the highest standards of ethical conduct and operational excellence.

proposals.title: stockholder proposal regarding special meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Requests bylaw amendment giving holders of 10% of outstanding common stock power to call a special shareowners meeting without exceptions applying only to shareowners.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because stockholders have consistently supported Chevron's current By-Law regarding special meetings.

proposals.title: stockholder proposal regarding independent chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Requests policy and bylaw amendment requiring the Board Chair be an independent director whenever possible, phased in at the next CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: Your Board recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal because your Board believes that stockholder interests are best served when Directors have the flexibility to determine the best person to serve as Chairman
